I was unable to find any information regarding the typology of communicative silence developed by Dr. Mereana Tāwhiri in Chapter 2 of "The Deafening Silence: Non-Verbal Communication in Four Pacific Societies."

Since the interlibrary loan copy hasn't arrived and your paper is due soon, I recommend reaching out to your professor or classmates to see if they have access to the book. Additionally, exploring academic databases or library catalogs may lead you to a digital copy or excerpts from the chapter. If you can get in touch with your university library's reference desk, they might also provide assistance in accessing the required materials quickly.
